correctness.rationale: Among 27 ternary triples, 3 are fixed by J and 12 two-element orbits remain. The full orbit-signature table proves all twelve orbits yield odd cut crossing (five). With one omission, fixed-vertex parity forces that omission to be the orbit 121, which has zero cut crossings; hence 11 cannot occur either. The cyclic ten-symbol witness has ten distinct nonfixed orbit representatives. Standalone checker independently reconstructs signatures and directly checks all 767637 cyclic words of lengths 10–12. Thus proof, assumptions, boundaries and finite computations align.

value.rationale: Determines the exact natural maximum of the smallest order-three alphabet parameter that the motivating 2026 paper explicitly lists as unresolved, resolving the published gap 10≤M≤11. The two interacting orbit-parity invariants are a structural obstruction explaining the failure of the last possible period, rather than an arbitrary sample or mere verification of a known witness. Scope is one small exact invariant, not a claimed general asymptotic advance.
